senses.gloss: (cmp. כָּמַר) [to be heated in the ground,] to be hidden, lie in wait.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 4:1">Maasr. IV, 1</cite> <he>המְכַמֵּן</he> Mish. a. Bab. ed. (Ms. M. <he>המכמיר</he>, Y. ed. <he>המכמר</he>, v. <cite ref="K00817"><he>כָּמַר</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to keep witnesses hidden, a proceeding applied only against seducers to idolatry (v. מֵסִית).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:10">Snh. VII, 10</cite> <he>מַכְמִינִין לו עדים וכ׳</he> the court puts witnesses in wait for him behind an enclosure. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᵈ bot.; a. e.—Y. Snh. VIII, 21ᶜ top <he>המַכְמִין עדיו וכ׳</he> he who keeps witnesses hidden (while eliciting a confession of indebtedness from his debtor), has done nothing, i.e. the confession has no legal consequences.
